Details: ModularDimension[c, irrep, k] gives the dimension of the weight-k vector-valued modular forms of the irrep: from the weight profile (ranks 1-5, Hilbert series) cross-checked with the k >= 2 trace formula, or the trace formula alone beyond profile coverage; Missing["UnknownDimension", reason] where neither applies (weight one above rank 5).

Negative weights and weights with rho(S^2) != e^{i Pi k} give 0 (for integer k this is the parity rho(S^2) = (-1)^k; every non-integer k gives 0 for an SL(2,Z) quotient, since rho(S^2) = +-1); k is an exact rational; weight zero gives 1 for the trivial irrep only. Exponents are certified exact T phases; numerical matrices fail with MissingExactSpectrum. Options Method and DimensionCache.
ModularDimension.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularDimension[g, d, 8]]

Details: ModularDimensionData[c, irrep, k] gives the dimension with its method (TraceFormula, Parity, CentralPhase, WeightZero, NegativeWeight, Profile, Unknown), hypotheses, exponents, Tr L, central sign, profile and evidence. The dimension formula decides wherever it applies; a weight profile that disagrees with it is reported under Diagnostics. At weight 1 the record also carries the formula value (FormulaValue) and a Caveat, since the formula may be incorrect there.
ModularDimensionData.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularDimensionData[g, d, 6]["Method"]]

Details: ModularDimensionTable[c] gives the table of every irrep at the weights Range[0, 20] (option Weights; exact rationals) as a document that displays itself as in v1: index, name, automatic label, dimension, then one column per weight, "-" for no forms and "/" where the formula cannot be evaluated; weight-1 values come from the formula with a note. ModularDimensionTable[c, irreps, weights] selects irreps (indices or IDs) and weights. DisplayData[table]["Table"] gives the values as index -> weight -> dimension.
ModularDimensionTable.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Values[First[DisplayData[ModularDimensionTable[g, {d}, Range[0, 8]]]["Table"]]]]

Details: ModularWeightProfile[c, irrep] gives the weights of a free basis of the module of vector-valued modular forms: k0 + {0}, {0, 2}, {0, 2, 4} for ranks 1-3, the cyclic {0, 2, 4, 6} or noncyclic {0, 2, 2, 4} type for rank 4, and the unique justified of the five rank-5 types; Missing["UnknownProfile", reason] above rank 5; inconsistent data fail with InconsistentProfile.
ModularWeightProfile.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularWeightProfile[g, d]]

Details: MinimumModularWeight[c, irrep] gives the smallest weight with a nonzero form: the first profile weight, or a bounded search over established dimensions (WeightSearchLimit) that reports Missing["UnknownMinimumWeight", ...] for unknown weights before the first positive one and Missing["SearchLimitReached", limit] otherwise. An irrep with rho(S^2) != +-1 (a cover group) has no admissible integer weight: Missing["UnknownMinimumWeight", <|"CentralPhase", "Reason"|>].
DimensionMethod chooses the Method of the dimensions it computes.
MinimumModularWeight.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; MinimumModularWeight[g, d]]

Details: ModularFormExistQ[c, irrep, k] gives True or False for an established dimension and the Missing value for an unknown one; unknown is neither zero nor existence.
ModularFormExistQ.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; {ModularFormExistQ[g, d, 2], ModularFormExistQ[g, d, 3]}]

Details: CleanModularDimensionCache[c] removes the derived dimension cache entries of the group of c (All, the default, removes every entry) and returns <|"Removed" -> n|>; forms and GAP state are untouched.
CleanModularDimensionCache.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; (ModularDimension[g, d, 4]; CleanModularDimensionCache[g]["Removed"] >= 1)]

Details: Option of the modular dimension functions: whether derived dimensions are cached, keyed by the actual S and T matrices, the assignment, the weight and the method.
True (default) or False.

20 (default) or a nonnegative integer.

Details: ModularFormQExp[y, n] computes the q-expansion of y below order n (default 5) and stores it in y atomically (y["QExpansion"]); it returns y. A stored expansion with the same coefficient binding that covers n is reused and a longer one is never shortened; the update never changes weight, representation, definition or normalization.
Unresolved coefficients fail with UnresolvedCoefficients unless ApplyCoefficients -> False; a finite jet cannot be extended (InsufficientOrder).
ModularFormQExp.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; QExpansionCoefficients[ModularFormQExp[CreateModularForm[g, one, 4, ModularFormDefinition[{ScalarModularExpression["E4", q]}, q]], 3]["QExpansion"]]["Components"]]

Details: Option of ModularFormExpression, ModularFormValue, ModularFormQExp and ModularFormEvaluate: whether the resolved relative coefficients are applied.
True (default) or False (the raw parameterized definition; numerical evaluation then fails with SymbolicCoefficients).
ApplyCoefficients.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Head[ModularFormQExp[First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]], 2, ApplyCoefficients -> False]]]

Details: ModularFormDerivative[y] gives D_k y = q dy/dq - k E2 y/12 as a new form of weight k + 2 with the same representation; the source recipe and coefficient binding are frozen (no live pointer), an extendible source stays extendible, and a zero derivative is a valid zero form (for example D_{1/2} eta = 0). The weight k may be rational. y is unchanged.
ModularFormDerivative.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularFormWeight[ModularFormDerivative[First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]]]]

Details: ChangeModularFormBasis[y, b] gives the form b . y with representation b rho b^-1 as a new object whose basis ID is the content identity of the new matrices (as a group's own variant of those matrices), without rescaling; the anchor frame becomes A . b^-1 (the same normalization functional), and expansions and definitions are transformed consistently.
ChangeModularFormBasis.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Module[{y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]}, ModularFormRep[ChangeModularFormBasis[y, {{0, 1}, {1, 0}}]] =!= ModularFormRep[y]]]

Details: ModularFormEvaluate[y, point] evaluates y at TauPoint[tau] or QPoint[q, sheet] by an adaptive q-series and returns <|"Value", "WorkingPrecision", "AccuracyGoal", "EstimatedError", "Method", "Order", "Branch", "Tau", "Converged", "ValidationStatus", "VerificationStatus"|>; read-only.

Options: Method (Automatic, "QSeries"; "Analytic" is unavailable), WorkingPrecision (80), AccuracyGoal and PrecisionGoal (Automatic), SeriesOrder, MaxSeriesOrder (2000), TimeLimit (600), ApplyCoefficients.
ModularFormEvaluate.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Module[{y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]}, ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; Length[ModularFormEvaluate[y, TauPoint[I], WorkingPrecision -> 30]["Value"]]]]

Details: ValidateModularForm[y] gives a read-only report <|"Checks" -> <|"RecordBinding", "Dimension", "Parity", "TExpansion", "Recipe", "Normalization", "STransformation"|>, "ProofStatus", "Remedies"|> with each check's status (Proven, ExactThroughOrder, Numerical, NotAvailable, Failed).
Exact checks through an order and numerical samples are evidence, never a proof of a global identity; RequireProof -> True fails unless every check is a proof.

Options: WorkingPrecision -> 40 (numerical samples; the S/T check passes below 10^-(WorkingPrecision/2)) and SeriesOrder -> Automatic (6 for the exact T and normalization checks; for the S/T samples an order covering the weight's coefficient growth and the series tail at the validation points, listed as "Order" in the STransformation check). An explicit SeriesOrder is used for every check. The validation points are disjoint from the normalization fit and holdout points.

No implemented route produces Proven at present (there is no exact identity certificate, and the S check is sampled), so RequireProof -> True currently refuses every form and model result with ProofRequired.

The report's "VerificationStatus" is the form's status: a new form is "Unverified"; a "NumericalEvidence" or "Proven" result is recorded in the form (its Validation "Status", at the same revision, so the bindings that pin the revision stay valid; it is saved with the form) and raises the status to "Numerical" or "Exact". New coefficients (ModularFormGetCoeff) reset it to "Unverified"; copies already bound into models keep their binding-time status. A normalization anchor that agrees only numerically is "Numerical", never "Proven".
ValidateModularForm.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Module[{y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]}, ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; ValidateModularForm[y]["ProofStatus"]]]
